environment.description: Lambda container image deployed on Amazon EKS cluster (self-managed node group, Kubernetes 1.27) using the Lambda Runtime Interface Emulator. The container runs as a WSGI application behind an internal NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection). Pod runs in 'lambda-workloads' namespace with no PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. The raw_http_handler path is active, receiving unfiltered HTTP requests directly from the NLB. No API Gateway in the request path.
